summary_md: **Dante Martin ([@DanteMMartin](https://x.com/DanteMMartin/status/2116523944329289873))** highlights Chris Wellons' **Prospero**, a C++/Dear ImGui coding harness he describes as about 100x lighter than mainstream tools, with subagents, SSH deploy, desktop control and any local model via llama.cpp, arguing a harness is essentially curl glued to popen() ([Prospero: a new coding harness for a more civilized age](https://nullprogram.com/blog/2026/10/31/)).

relevance: Lean native harness that works with local models.
